subject: Post-call: deployment path handoff & POC playbook
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medflow.health>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: deployment path handoff & POC playbook

Thanks for your time earlier, Daniel — quick recap and proposed next steps from our call. I outlined a pragmatic POC that lets MedFlow validate both performance and security requirements while keeping time-to-value short.

High-level summary of needs you mentioned:
- PHI in inference pipeline; strong data isolation + audit logs required
- Target latency SLA: 99th percentile < 250ms for 512-token prompts
- Throughput target for pilot: ~200 concurrent inference sessions (burst tolerant)
- Procurement timeline: internal budget sign-off by Oct 1

Suggested POC approach (two-track, adaptive):
1) Fast-start: Hosted API sandbox for integration & functional validation (1–2 weeks)
2) Parallel evaluation: Dedicated capacity sizing and run (weeks 2–4)
3) Private/VPC feasibility: dry-run of VPC deployment and key rotation in lab (weeks 4–5)

Success criteria (what we will measure):
- Functional: end-to-end requests working with your client-side SDKs
- Performance: p99 latency < 250ms during baseline traffic, sustained QPS matching workload profile
- Security: data retention controls in place, encryption at rest/in transit, audit log entries for inference requests
- Ops: clear runbook for failover (hosted -> dedicated -> private) and a rollback plan

Proposed timeline (compressed):
- Week 0: kick-off, access & credentials, SOC2 evidence share
- Week 1: Hosted integration + smoke tests
- Week 2: Dedicated sizing tests (throughput/latency)
- Week 3: Private VPC dry-run (networking + KMS integration)
- Week 4: Evaluation, compile metrics & exec review

Immediate asks for MedFlow:
- Confirm whether PHI will require private VPC from day 1 or whether a dedicated/contractual isolation is acceptable for pilot
- Provide a 2-week window where 2–3 engineers can join our deep-dive
- Share procurement contact for timeline alignment (PO/contract lead)

I attached a starter POC-criteria.xlsx with measurable checks we can use.

Next steps I propose: schedule a 60-minute technical deep-dive (networking + auth + perf) next week. If you confirm the preference for private VPC we will loop infra early.

Thanks — I’ll follow up internally to assign owners and a detailed schedule.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medflow.health>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medflow.health>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment path handoff & POC playbook

Appreciate the clear plan, Karthik. Quick answers from our side:
- PHI: yes, we process PHI. Our preferred target is Private VPC long-term.
- Pilot openness: we can do a hosted sandbox for initial functional tests if we can ensure a contract-level isolation guarantee (single-tenant/dedicated pool) and written controls on data retention. If not, we need the private VPC path.
- Engineers: we can spare 3 engineers for the pilot (one infra, two backend) starting Sept 20.
- Procurement: I own the budget request; need the cost estimate and a draft MPA to present to legal — target sign-off by Oct 1 as discussed.

I attached our PHI-requirements doc so you can map controls to the POC. Schedule the deep-dive; Sept 15 looks workable for our infra lead.

— Daniel
Daniel Park
CTO, MedFlow Health
daniel.park@medflow.health | 415-867-0210

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-call: deployment path handoff & POC playbook

Looping you all to assign owners and scope tasks. Quick asks below; Daniel confirmed PHI handling and prefers private VPC long-term but is willing to do hosted-first if contractual isolation is acceptable.

Lauren — can you own the POC program management and exec updates? Owner asks: calendar cadence, customer comms, and collating procurement requirements.

Monica — can you lead the tech deep-dive (networking, latency profile, SDK integration). Please prepare a short test plan for the hosted -> dedicated -> private flow and a sample quantized model config.

Sergio — please draft:
- Dedicated sizing options (N GPUs / expected p99 latencies for 512 tokens)
- Private VPC checklist (networking, peering, KMS/HSM considerations, audit logging endpoints)
- Minimum infra runbook for a 6-week pilot and a dry-run checklist we can share with MedFlow

Proposed compressed schedule (we will adjust after deep-dive):
- Week 0 (kickoff): access, SOC2 evidence exchange, HubSpot deal creation
- Week 1: hosted integration + smoke tests (functionality)
- Week 2: dedicated sizing tests (throughput/latency under load)
- Week 3: private VPC dry-run (networking/KMS)
- Week 4: extended eval & metrics collection
- Week 5: exec review and recommended path

Attachments for internal use: trial-schedule-snapshot.png, draft-cs-mpa.docx (put in Drive link). Please add estimated engineering effort and any dependencies by EOD Friday.

Karthik

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@medflow.health>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: deployment path handoff & POC playbook

Thanks all — I’ll coordinate the logistics. Confirming a 60-minute technical deep-dive on Tue, Sept 15 at 10:00 AM PT. Meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/medflow-poc-0915

What we will cover in the deep-dive:
- Networking and VPC peering requirements for Private deployment
- Auth and KMS integration options (HSM vs customer-managed keys)
- Performance baseline: how we measure p99/throughput and expected test harness
- Contractual isolation options for hosted/dedicated while legal reviews private deployment

Action items for MedFlow before the call:
- Share a point-of-contact for procurement/legal review (name + email)
- Confirm the infra engineer who will join (we have Sept 15 slot reserved)

I’ve added the meeting to HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234560/deal/DEAL-87234 and uploaded the initial POC checklist to the shared Drive folder.

Looking forward — I’ll send calendar invites and a short deep-dive agenda later today.

— Lauren
